Ends with a written decision: DAT Display or Fallback A/B/C.
prerequisites: Meta AI app >= V292, glasses firmware >= V128, Developer Mode on
Glasses slot G1 booked; app builds and streams against Mock Device Kit before the slot
Watch for DeviceSessionError.CAPABILITY_DENIED and report it to Meta immediately

dod.check: M0-spike.md records PASS or FAIL for each of (a)-(f) as table rows '| (a) | PASS |'
M0-spike.md ends the spike with a decision line
Web App hello screenshot from the Display Simulator exists
iOS app builds for the simulator (Xcode >= 26.4)
Web App builds, has the mrbd-web-app-capable meta tag and is under 300 KB
dod.command: npm --prefix hud-web run build && grep -q 'mrbd-web-app-capable' hud-web/index.html && python -c "import pathlib;s=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in pathlib.Path('hud-web/dist').rglob('*') if p.is_file());assert s<300*1024,s"

dod.check: Webcam MediaPipe Holistic bench recorded >= 15 fps (written by: python -m signer_core.sources.webcam --bench 10 --out .hackforge/evidence/M0-bench.json)
VOCAB.md lists >= 25 rows (24 signs + REST) with source popsign or own

dod.check: PopSign download script plans the vocabulary signs only; extractor CLI runs
